# BOOM Drinkware — full model catalogue

> Complete model-level reference for AI assistants and buyers. Brand: BOOM Drinkware. Site: https://www.boomdrinkware.com/. All prices on request; minimum order 10 pieces for stock-tool models.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2013
- Plant: 3,416 m², Shenzhen
- Equipment: injection moulding, silicone compression moulding and our own tooling shop in house; 65 machines across 4 production lines
- Quality: 4 full-time QA/QC inspectors, AQL sampling (under 500 pcs 5%, 500-2000 pcs 3%, over 2000 pcs 1%)
- Materials: plastic (PP, Tritan, AS, PS) and silicone; metal parts are sourced from vetted suppliers
- Terms: T/T 30% deposit and 70% against copy of B/L, FOB Shenzhen; PayPal for samples only
